title: A Universal Framework for Multiport Network Analysis of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces

With our framework, we model RISaided systems and RIS architectures through impedance, admittance, and scattering parameter analysis.
Based on these analyses, three equivalent models are derived accounting for the effects of impedance mismatching and mutual coupling.

Compared to the conventional communication model that does not account for mutual coupling in RIS, the mutual couplingaware model incorporating trained scattering parameters demonstrates improved prediction accuracy.

title: Spatio-Temporal Neural Network for Channel Prediction in Massive MIMO-OFDM Systems

snippets.quote: In this paper, we propose a spatio-temporal neural network (STNN) to achieve better performance by carefully taking into account the spatio-temporal characteristics of CSI.
Specifically, STNN uses its encoder and decoder modules to capture the spatial correlation and temporal dependence of CSI.

Evaluated on a realistic channel model with enhanced mobility and spherical waves, experimental results show that STNN can effectively improve the accuracy of prediction and perform well with respect to different signal to noise ratios (SNRs).

title: Spectral Temporal Graph Transformer for Massive MIMO CSI Prediction in 5G and Beyond
journal: 2025 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)

snippets.quote: We propose a Spectral Temporal Graph Transformer (STGT) that unifies graph-based spatial learning with transformer-based temporal attention to predict compressed CSI.
The model dynamically constructs data-driven graphs, performs spectral filtering to capture multi-scale spatial dependencies, and leverages self-attention to learn long-range temporal evolution.

Evaluations on realistic 3GPP TR 38.901 channel models across diverse SNR and mobility regimes show that STGT outperforms RNN/LSTM, vanilla transformers, and STEM-GNN in NMSE and spectral efficiency, while maintaining robustness under high mobility and aggressive compression.

title: An ERAN-Based Dynamic Graph Neural Network for CSI Prediction in Massive MIMO Systems

snippets.quote: In this letter, we adapt the evolving relational attention network (ERAN)—a generic spatio-temporal graph neural network (GNN)—for CSI prediction.
ERAN dynamically learns evolving adjacency matrices using a gated recurrent unit (GRU)-driven evolving graph learning (EGL) module, enabling it to capture dependencies among multiple variables.

Experiments show that at high mobility ( $\mu = 120$ km/h), ERAN achieves a 34.93% reduction in root-mean-square error (RMSE) compared to STEM, while incurring only a 5.64% drop in spectral efficiency (SE), in contrast to STEM’s 15.1% degradation—demonstrating nearly three times higher temporal robustness under severe dynamic conditions.
